about_the_game:
Deadhold is a roguelite tower defense game where your choices impact who lives and who dies (hopefully the zombies).

Gather survivors, scavenge for resources, and defend your community against the growing zombie horde!

Features:

  • Roguelite - Choices Matter

Every time you play a level, it's different. Randomization and choices means you can choose a favourite strategy, but you'll still have to adapt.

  • Flawed Survivors

Survivors act as your towers, except they can get tired, infected, and DIE!

They each have different weapons, positive and negative traits, and can level up, giving you unique combinations to play with!

  • Scavenge vs Defend

Choose who uses their energy to scavenge in the day or defend the community at night.

Scavenging can get you resources, relics, and even new survivors, but comes with its own risks like infection, developing negative traits, and even attracting more powerful zombies for the next wave!

  • Secure & Fortify Locations

Secure scavenge locations to turn them into defensive positions, each with their own bonuses. e.g. A tall water tower provides more range, while a bunker boosts your survivor's damage reduction. There are many different types of locations to secure!

Improve locations with fortifications to further customize your defenses!

  • Defend Against The Horde

Do you place survivors to cover more zombie routes? or ensure your survivors can protect each other? Who is keeping the community's base (an RV) safe? These are important decisions to make to avoid being overrun by the undead horde!

  • Special Zombies

Walkers, Runners, Spitters, Brutes, and more! Lots of different types of zombies to kill!

Wishlist & Follow us to keep an eye on the game as it develops!

We appreciate your interest and support!
